name: truevalue
description: Collecteur des 4 sources de données football : Arbworld (Betfair), Polymarket, ESPN et SportScore.

scripts.build: node --check server.js && for f in src/*.js test/*.js site/*.js site/modules/*.js site/modules/views/*.js site/modules/ui/*.js site-legacy/*.js site-legacy/modules/*.js cloudflare/*.js; do [ -e "$f" ] && node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint: eslint . && node --check server.js && for f in src/*.js test/*.js site/*.js site/modules/*.js site/modules/views/*.js site/modules/ui/*.js site-legacy/*.js site-legacy/modules/*.js cloudflare/*.js; do [ -e "$f" ] && node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
